unlisted_practices: Evaluating open-source LLMs on inference speed and instruction-following alongside accuracy to guide deployment model selection
Reporting macro-averaged model rankings with robustness checks across aggregation scheme and language stratification

screen.reason: The study develops and executes an extensive automated benchmarking framework (OpenMedEval) testing 172 open-source LLMs across medical examination and question datasets, evaluating accuracy and efficiency trade-offs without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
